verdict.rationale: Highnote documents that its in-house compliance team manages KYC and KYB, and that issuance is gated on an approved account-holder application. It also documents a manual-review state, with a Document Upload SDK for collecting identity documents during that review. That covers the core of verification built into issuance, but most of the operational detail in the story is unevidenced. Missing for 10: documented KYC/KYB data requirements, a full set of review/application states beyond manual review and approval, re-verification flows, and independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an ops user, cardholder verification is built into issuance — KYC for consumers and KYB for businesses run through the platform with documented data requirements, review states, and re-verification flows

citations.quote: Our in-house compliance and operations teams manage Know Your Customer (KYC) and Know Your Business (KYB) regulatory compliance
Once you have an account holder with an approved application, you can issue a financial account.
The Highnote Document Upload SDK lets you collect identity verification documents from account holders when a card product application enters manual review.
